name: Shanghai Phoenix Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Shanghai, China, Shanghai Phoenix Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. is deeply involved in the entire process of bicycle manufacturing, from conceptual design and engineering to production and distribution across the domestic Chinese market. Beyond its core cycling operations, the company also diversifies into property development and construction ventures, alongside providing certain financial services. Its products enjoy an international reach, being exported to regions including Europe, Latin America, and the United States. The group rebranded to its current name in January 2016, having previously traded as Jinshan Development & Construction Co., Ltd.
